# Security Checklist: System Audio Capture Pivot

**Purpose**: Validate privacy, consent, diagnostics, egress, and local artifact
requirements before implementation planning proceeds to tasks.
**Created**: 2026-06-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based
on feature context and requirements. Items test the requirements and design
artifacts, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are permission requirements complete for microphone granted/denied/restricted/stale states and Screen/System Audio granted/denied/restricted/stale states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-005, Data Model §SystemAudioCaptureSession]
- [x] CHK002 Are explicit capture-scope approval requirements complete enough to prevent arbitrary background system audio from becoming meeting content? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-015, Data Model §CaptureScopeApproval]
- [x] CHK003 Are metadata-only diagnostics requirements complete for CPU, frame, permission, scope, and manifest evidence without storing raw samples or meeting content? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Contract §Validation Evidence]
- [x] CHK004 Are external egress exclusions complete for upload, MediaScribe, Langfuse content traces, server storage, credentials, and signed URLs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Plan §Constraints]
- [x] CHK005 Are local artifact lifecycle requirements complete enough to distinguish saved, degraded, blocked, and failed recordings for later deletion truth? [Completeness, Contract §Dual-Track Manifest, Constitution §IV]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is "approved meeting app/window/display scope" defined clearly enough to distinguish user-confirmed meeting scope from unrelated media playback? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §CaptureScopeApproval]
- [x] CHK007 Is the difference between normal accepted recording and explicit degraded attempt unambiguous for permission-denied states? [Clarity, Spec §US2, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK008 Are forbidden diagnostic fields named specifically enough to guide redaction tests and support bundle behavior? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Contract §Capture Session]
- [x] CHK009 Is protected/blocked audio terminology defined clearly enough to avoid presenting uncapturable audio as successful recording? [Clarity, Spec §US3, Data Model §SystemAudioCaptureSession]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Are the no-HAL/no-driver MVP requirements consistent between constitution, PRD, spec, plan, and contracts? [Consistency, Constitution §I, Spec §FR-007, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK011 Are local-first/no-egress requirements consistent between spec, plan, manifest contract, and diagnostics contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Contract §Dual-Track Manifest]
- [x] CHK012 Are permission blocker requirements consistent with the visible consent and one-action stop governance rules? [Consistency, Constitution §II, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK013 Are future driver references consistently marked as future advanced-routing work rather than MVP acceptance work? [Consistency, Spec §Out Of Scope, Plan §Project Structure]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK014 Are requirements defined for permission revocation during active recording, including user-visible state and artifact outcome? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK015 Are requirements defined for protected/blocked incoming audio, silent incoming audio, missing incoming frames, and dropped frames as separate evidence classes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016, Data Model §SystemAudioCaptureSession]
- [x] CHK016 Are requirements defined for app crash or failed finalization without leaking raw content or falsely claiming deletion/egress status? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Capture Session]
- [x] CHK017 Are requirements defined for support diagnostics that include enough evidence for troubleshooting without exposing sensitive paths, raw audio, transcript text, or secrets? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, Contract §Validation Evidence]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Are privacy/security acceptance criteria measurable enough to be converted into tasks and tests without adding new rules during implementation? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK019 Are degraded/blocked/failed manifest acceptance rules specific enough to prevent false saved/success states? [Measurability, Contract §Dual-Track Manifest]
- [x] CHK020 Are no-egress acceptance rules objectively verifiable through manifest fields and diagnostics evidence? [Measurability, Contract §Dual-Track Manifest]
